scope: Online stochastic CMC effective-woven FE2 small macro fixture; original all-point driver, not experimental geometry or validated fracture.
assumptions: The existing woven voxel geometry and tow orientations are reused. Its volume fraction and dimensions are not the measured CMC architecture.
Tow shear moduli are explicit closure assumptions: G12=G13 approximately sqrt(E1*E2)/(2*(1+nu12)), G23=E2/(2*(1+nu23)); they have not been measured or calibrated.
delta=0.03 is a stiffness sensitivity input. The orthotropic block perturbation is not a fitted full-matrix dispersion.
This example is elastic only and does not use the legacy epoxy damage law.
